preprocessing.evidence: pinned preprocessor_config.json: image_processor_type=RTDetrImageProcessor, size={height:640,width:640}, do_pad=false, do_rescale=true, rescale_factor=0.00392156862745098, do_normalize=false, resample=2(bilinear); verified against the official transformers RTDetrImageProcessor.resize semantics ({height,width} resizes to the exact size and does NOT keep the aspect ratio)
preprocessing.inverse_rule: exactly one inverse scaling point: raw normalized boxes decode to model-input pixels and are mapped back to original pixels through weblabel_detector.transforms.inverse_resize; the canonical mapping is then applied through transform_to_canonical; never combine this with a second post-process target_sizes scaling

runtime.implementation_note: real inference additionally needs the torch/transformers runtime declared as the 'real' extra of pyproject.toml; the worker reports needs_configuration when they are absent and never fakes output
